notes.title: v0.1.4.5 Update – More Zombies, Deadly Traps, and Action at Its Peak!
notes.content:
[p]🧩 [b]1899: Secrets of the Maze – v0.1.4.5 Update is Live![/b][/p][p]🎯 [b]Highlights:[/b][/p][p]🧟‍♂️ [b]Zombie Count Increased[/b]
The maze is now far more dangerous! Expect higher zombie density — stay alert.[/p][p]🪓 [b]Melee Weapons Enhanced[/b]
– Axe and knife damage increased.
– The axe can now kill certain enemies with a single hit!
– Bonus: Axe, knife, and lighter now emit light in darkness![/p][p]🔫 [b]Pistol Updated with Auto-Reload Feature[/b]
Enjoy a smoother combat experience with automatic reloading.[/p][p]🔴 [b]Laser Traps Introduced[/b]
Sudden laser beams now test your reflexes. Watch your step at all times![/p][p]🎵 [b]Music Control Added[/b]
You can now completely mute background music via the [i]Music Volume[/i] setting.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Action System Finalized[/b]
Melee combat, gunfights, traps, and survival in darkness are now fully implemented.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ [b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][p]🔫 [b]Weapon Damage Boosted[/b]
Defeat enemies much more efficiently![/p][p]🕯️ [b]Explore with the Lantern[/b]
Illuminate your path and uncover the maze’s secrets using the lantern item.[/p][p]🎒 [b]Inventory System Rebalanced[/b]
– Pistol Ammo: 3 boxes (33 bullets each)
– Flashlight Battery: Max 6 units
– Lantern Ammo: Max 3 units
– Medical Kit: 1 unit
– Healing Elixir: Max 33 units[/p][p]💾 [b]Autosave System Implemented[/b]
The game now auto-saves when reaching specific coordinates. Your progress is protected from sudden deaths.[/p][p]🌐 [b]Asian Font Fixes[/b]
Font issues resolved for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Note: Minor font glitches may still appear in some UI elements (like Q/Inspect and E/Use keys), but all story notes display perfectly across languages. Tested in both Editor and Steam builds.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Steam DRM Launch Issue Resolved[/b]
Startup problems caused by Steam DRM have been fixed. The game should now launch reliably.[/p][p]🚪 [b]Quit Button Issue Fixed[/b]
A bug that prevented proper exiting via the Quit button has been addressed. Exits now work as expected.[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎥 Live Stream: 1899 v0.1.4.5 Update & New Dangers
notes.content:
[p]🎥 Join the [i]1899: Secrets of the Maze[/i] live stream as we explore the dangers introduced in the [b]v0.1.4.5 update[/b]![/p][p]🧩 New traps, intense zombie encounters, and unexpected mechanics are now in the game.
We'll showcase these features [b]live in action[/b] and [b]answer your questions[/b] in real-time.[/p][p]🧪 The developer will also share behind-the-scenes insights and explain the decisions behind the update.[/p][p]🖥️ Plus, [i]1899: Secrets of the Maze[/i] players are encouraged to host their [b]own live streams[/b] while exploring this update!
Whether it’s on Twitch, YouTube, or Steam — share your experience and guide others through the maze.
Use the hashtag [b]#1899Maze[/b] and get featured on our social media and community page![/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Upcoming Update v0.1.4.3 + Font Issues & Lantern Tips
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Maze Runners,[/b][/p][p]🎯 A new update is coming soon for [i]1899: Secrets of the Maze[/i]: [b]v0.1.4.3[/b][/p][p]🔹 What’s coming in this version:[/p][list][*][p]Localization improvements (Korean, Japanese, Chinese)[/p][/*][/list][p]⚠️ [b]Font Display Issues:[/b]
We’re currently aware of missing character issues (square boxes) in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.
The issue doesn’t appear in-editor but happens in the game build. I’m investigating it and hope to fix it soon.[/p][p]🎥 [b]New Video – “The Power of the Lantern”[/b]
I’ve published a video showing how important the Lantern is.
Watch [i]The Power of the Lantern[/i] and discover the deeper meaning of light in the maze.[/p][p]🕯️ [b]Short Gameplay Tips:[/b]
Every object in the game has a story.
Try alternate paths and creative solutions to escape the maze and enjoy the mystery.
If you want to finish quickly, check [b]Note 19[/b] and [b]Note 20[/b] for essential info about the Lantern.[/p][p]💡 [b]About Difficulty:[/b]
The game is intentionally designed to be quite easy.
If you encounter something hard, there’s likely a hidden solution to balance the challenge.
Please explore and experiment — there’s always a way out![/p][p]Thanks for your support — and don’t get lost in the dark![/p]
